Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up, and great question. Short answer: yes, we can do a short-term uplift with a few options depending on predictability and whether you want a capped overrun or a true-up. Below is a quick sketch; happy to formalize into an amendment.

Options (high level):
1) One-time burst credit + soft cap
   - We apply a one-time credit that covers X tokens (matched to your prediction).
   - For any consumption beyond the credit, a soft overrun rate applies (we cap incremental unit cost to avoid surprise).
2) Temporary rate-limit increase (token/sec)
   - We bump your token/sec limit for the 72-hour window. No infra changes required; route through our hosted burst pool.
   - Requests beyond the configured soft cap billed at negotiated overrun rate.
3) Pre-purchased short window capacity
   - Purchase a small dedicated burst allotment (reserve for 72 hours) at a reduced uplift price; best for guaranteed throughput.

What I need from you: an expected token volume estimate for the 72-hour window and whether procurement prefers a capped overage or a true-up after the event. If procurement needs amendment language I can draft a one-page addendum and loop finance/legal.

Im ccing Hannah (sales lead) — Hannah, any wiggle room on a one-time credit for a strategic pilot?

Best,
